content.title: Dialogue Comedy | Two-Shot Pause and Silent Reaction
content.summary: When two characters are in the same frame, first establish eye contact, leave a clear pause after the first line of dialogue, then deliver the second line of dialogue and end with the first character's silent reaction; the specific dialogue and comedic meaning must be completely new and original.

quick_start.input_format: Medium shot of two characters + first character speaks briefly + a readable pause + second character speaks briefly + silent reaction from the first character
quick_start.recommended_input: Two original museum night shift security guards sit opposite each other in the lounge: A asks if the statue blinked. After a pause, B calmly replies, "Only when you look away." Finally, A silently looks toward the dark exhibition hall door without adding a second punchline.
required_anchors: Opening medium shot of two characters establishes a stable eyeline
Only retain one round of dialogue from the first character
There is a clear pause between the two rounds of dialogue
The second character speaks only once and moves with restraint
At the end, the first character responds silently and no additional lines of dialogue are added.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: When two people are in the same frame, they first establish eye contact, leave a clear pause after the first round of speaking, and then complete the second round of speaking and end with the first person's silent reaction; the specific dialogue and comedy semantics must be completely new and original.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Use a neutral two-shot to establish equal conversational footing, show one visible speaking turn, hold a clearly readable pause, show a second speaking turn, and end on the first speaker's silent reaction. The source supports only this visual turn-taking and reaction grammar; any question, answer meaning or comic mismatch is an explicitly original instantiation slot, never a source-derived fact.

invariants.rule: Begin with a neutral two-shot and stable eye lines.
invariants.purpose: Makes later singles spatially and socially legible.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening on isolated faces hides the relationship.

invariants.rule: Use one compact first speaking turn, with its meaning supplied only by the new original instance.
invariants.purpose: Creates a clean expectation without inventing source semantics.
invariants.ablation_failure: Multiple setup turns blur ownership and weaken the pause.

invariants.rule: Hold one clearly readable pause between the two visible speaking turns.
invariants.purpose: Builds a timing interval without inventing source semantics.
invariants.ablation_failure: An immediate second turn removes the visible timing contrast.

invariants.rule: Use one compact second speaking turn with minimal gesture; its meaning is an original instance variable.
invariants.purpose: Preserves the visible turn-taking structure while allowing new content.
invariants.ablation_failure: A large performance or extra line turns the held exchange into a sketch montage.

invariants.rule: End on the first character's silent reaction with no additional speaking turn.
invariants.purpose: Lets the final visible reaction complete the timing pattern.
invariants.ablation_failure: Additional speaking turns weaken the final hold.
